description: Increasing the loan amount granted by the Asian Development Bank under the Policy Based Lending - 2026
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-03-16 to obtain US$ 380 million through the Asian Development Bank’s Policy-Based Lending during the year 2026. Out of this, US$ 100 million has been allocated for the Trade, Investment and Industrial Development Programme - Sub-Programme 1. However, amid the current economic uncertainty arising from the Middle East crisis and climate related shocks, the Asian Development Bank has agreed to provide assistance by increasing the loan amount under the said sub-programme to US$ 200 million through an additional financing package of US$ 100 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to take the relevant steps to obtain the said loan amount, was approved by the Cabinet.
